en-US: Mithka 1.7.11 improves forum-topic navigation, adaptive phone and tablet layouts, sender-filtered search, profile links, and notification exceptions. Music and voice playback handle account changes and interruptions more reliably. This release also refines contact search, proxy status, message replies, rich-text editing, localization, and overall stability.
zh-Hans: Mithka 1.7.11 优化论坛话题导航、手机与平板自适应布局、按发送者搜索、个人资料链接和通知例外设置。音乐与语音播放在切换账号及播放中断时更加可靠，并改进联系人搜索、代理状态、消息回复、富文本编辑、多语言和整体稳定性。
